definitions.ask: Which statistic should the Net flow headline show so it always agrees with its shrinking/growing label?
definitions.why: The label describes how much the backlog changed over the window, which is exactly the total

choices.label: The window total, e.g. "−89 total · shrinking"; number and word share one value
The rounded daily mean, e.g. "−3/day · shrinking"; keeps /day, but small totals read "0/day" flat
